fire: On Saturday morning my sister went shopping for shoes downtown.
Dad stopped at the gas station to buy a newspaper and coffee.
Every evening I spend an hour looking up recipes online.
Mom went grocery shopping while we waited in the car.
She ran out to buy stamps before the post office closed.
He was looking up train times when the phone rang.
The kids went shopping for school supplies with their aunt.
We had to go out and buy batteries for the flashlight.
quiet: On Saturday morning my sister went jogging along the river.
Dad stopped at the gas station to ask for directions to the lake.
Every evening I spend an hour reading novels in bed.
Mom took a nap while we waited in the car.
She ran out to the garden before the rain started.
He was washing the dishes when the phone rang.
The kids went swimming at the lake with their aunt.
We had to stay inside because of the storm.
